title: Grateful Dead Live at The Ark on 1969-04-23
source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD

ai_review.summary: Excellent performance captured on a soundboard tape with generally good audio despite minor speed hiccups.
ai_review.review: The band delivered an excellent show, with reviewers noting the energy and tightness of the performance. The soundboard recording is described as very good overall, though a few speed anomalies suggest the original tape suffered some heat or moisture damage, giving it a slightly uneven feel.

ai_rating.rationale: A five‑star review highlights an outstanding musical performance and mostly solid soundboard audio; minor speed issues keep the rating just shy of perfect.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall mix, but occasional speed fluctuations and hints of tape damage (heat/moisture) make parts sound slightly slowed; minimal ambience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is praised as an excellent performance overall with no specific complaints about pacing or song order.
